Both leads are dealt with. One account is open; the other is on hold pending enhanced due diligence.

**L-6880, Mr Luke Smith (C-14133): complete.**
- KYC check returned VERIFIED. He is not a PEP, is rated STANDARD, and his ID, proof of address and source of funds are on file.
- Opened the Everyday Current Account as **A-61553C** and posted the M$2,000 deposit (D-0001).

**L-1603, Sig. Ferdinando Catenazzi (C-53926): not opened.**
- He is a PEP (Member of the Meridian National Assembly). His KYC check returned PENDING_EDD with an estimated 5 days.
- Under §4 of the AML policy, enhanced due diligence must finish before any account is opened, so I did not open the Premier Savings Account and did not take the M$3,200 deposit.
- I left his HIGH rating in place. I did not request or enter any exception, since those need Branch Manager and Compliance approval.
- The branch manager replied that he can't approve KYC/AML exceptions and that they would have to go through Compliance.
- The customer has been told why the account can't open yet. He is pressing for it to be open before month end, and the referral came from a senior colleague. The EDD will probably finish after the quarter closes.

The handover note has the follow-up: rerun the KYC check once EDD clears, then open the Premier Savings Account if it comes back VERIFIED.
